protocol.title: An Automated Single-Cell Droplet-Digital Microfluidic Platform for Monoclonal Antibody Discovery
cell_lines: Hybridoma cells (antigen-specific mAb producer, NRC Canada, confidential line)
Target cells (membrane-bound antigen-expressing, NRC Canada, confidential line)
protocol.objective: Deterministic single-cell co-encapsulation of hybridoma and target cells, on-demand droplet disruption and media exchange, antigen-specific mAb screening by fluorescence, and recovery of positive hybridoma cells for downstream antibody characterisation

layers: SU-8 dielectric layer, 7 um thick (layer ii)
sections: Device 1 -- Trapping array (100 traps, 50 per serpentine side)
Device 2 -- Flow-focusing droplet generator (target cells, ~30 pL, ~3 kHz)
Device 3 -- Co-planar binary electrode sorter (single target-cell selection)

inlets.inlet_2: PBS / Alexa Fluor 647 secondary Ab solution / target-cell droplets (re-injection)

outlets.outlet_1: Sample recovery (positive hybridoma droplets via reverse oil flow)

reagents.carrier_oil: HFE7500 + 2% Ran Fluoro-surfactant (2% w/v PEG fluoro-surfactant in HFE7500)
reagents.recovery_oil: Fluorinert FC-40 (~1 mL for PTFE membrane wash)

cell_media.hybridoma: IMDM + 10% heat-inactivated FBS + mouse IL-6 (1 ng/mL) + pen/strep; 37 C, 5% CO2
cell_media.target_cells: DMEM + 10% heat-inactivated FBS + G418 (0.4 mg/mL); 37 C, 5% CO2

secondary_antibody.purpose: Labels membrane-bound antigen-specific mAbs on target cell surface post-wash

reagents.wash_solution: PBS (Ca2+/Mg2+ free) containing Alexa Fluor 647 secondary antibody
reagents.capillary: Glass capillary pre-filled with HFE7500 2% Ran Fluoro-surfactant

steps.name: Device priming
steps.notes: 2% Pluronics F-127 in PBS flowed at 50 nL/s for 5 min (outlet 1 closed). Flow rate then reduced to 1 nL/s and outlet 1 opened. Reduces non-specific cell adhesion to PDMS channel walls.

steps.name: Target cell staining and encapsulation (Device 2)
steps.stain: CellTrace CFSE (5 uM, 1e6 cells/mL in PBS)
steps.resuspension: IMDM (10% FBS + IL-6, no antibiotic, 1e6 cells/mL)
steps.notes: Device 2 generates monodisperse ~30 pL droplets at ~3 kHz. Target cells stained with CFSE before loading to enable fluorescence-based sorting in Device 3.

steps.name: Single target-cell droplet sorting (Device 3)
steps.operation: co-planar binary electrode sorting by fluorescence
steps.sorting_threshold: Fluorescence above single-cell threshold and below two-cell threshold
steps.collection: Gas-tight glass syringe filled with HFE7500 oil

pass.action: mix oil spacer, hold for re-injection

steps.notes: PMT-based photon counting triggers electrode actuation. Only droplets containing exactly 1 target cell are collected. Multi-cell and empty droplets sent to waste.

steps.name: Hybridoma cell staining and trapping (Device 1)
steps.stain: CellTrace Calcein Red-Orange AM (1e6 cells/mL in IMDM)
steps.resuspension: IMDM (10% FBS + IL-6, no antibiotic, 1e6 cells/mL)
steps.operation: hydrodynamic single-cell trapping (abstracted as mix in BioScript)
steps.trap_design: 7 um constriction; fluidic resistance blocks outlet when cell occupies trap

pass.action: dispense fresh IMDM, proceed to encapsulation

steps.notes: Hydrodynamic confinement by fluidic resistance. Open trap Rtrap < Rbypass; when occupied Rtrap increases, next cell flows to next open trap. Device primed with Pluronics F-127 to reduce cell adhesion. Cell concentration kept at 1e6/mL in IMDM.

steps.name: In situ droplet generation around trapped hybridoma (Device 1)
steps.notes: IMDM medium replaced by oil flowing at 1 nL/s. Electrodes actuated at 32 Vrms / 15 kHz to shear aqueous phase and generate in situ droplet around trapped single hybridoma cell. Deterministic -- no Poisson statistics.

steps.name: Deterministic co-encapsulation (droplet merge, Device 1)
steps.notes: Sorted single-target-cell droplets re-injected from inlet 2 at 5 nL/s, interleaved with oil spacer at 1 nL/s from a separate inlet. When target-cell droplet arrives at a trap, electrode beneath is actuated (32 Vrms / 15 kHz) to merge it with in situ hybridoma droplet. 95 +/- 3.2% efficiency at 5 nL/s -- highest reported co-encapsulation efficiency without preliminary sorting of both cell types or microvalve systems.

steps.name: On-chip co-incubation
steps.notes: Two-cell droplets incubated on-chip for 30 min at room temperature. Hybridoma secretes mAbs into confined droplet. Antigen-specific mAbs diffuse and bind to membrane-bound antigens on co-encapsulated target cell. Non-specific mAbs remain free in droplet volume.

steps.name: Droplet disruption and PBS/Alexa Fluor 647 wash (Device 1)
steps.wash_solution: PBS + Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated goat anti-mouse IgG (H+L)
steps.notes: PBS/Alexa647 solution flowed at 1-5 nL/s. Electrode beneath traps actuated at 64 Vrms / 15 kHz to disrupt droplet interface via electrostatic force. Non-specific mAbs washed out through constriction. Antigen-specific mAbs retained on target cell membrane. After wash, PBS flow reduced to 0.1 nL/s and oil flow increased to 5 nL/s to re-form droplet in situ around both cells. 96.8% fluorescence reduction after 1 wash step (~5 min for 50 traps).

steps.name: Fluorescence detection and antibody binding screening
steps.detection_channel: Alexa Fluor 647 (ex 627 nm / em 665 nm, 300 ms exposure)
steps.signal_definition: Mean fluorescence intensity of target cell membrane > mean fluorescence of surrounding droplet
steps.snr_improvement_post_wash: Significant (P < 0.05 between binding and non-binding hybridomas)
steps.notes: Antigen-specific mAbs bound to target cell membrane are labelled by Alexa Fluor 647 secondary antibody, generating localised red fluorescence around target cell. Non-specific mAbs washed away in S8. SNR significantly higher post-wash for antigen-specific hybridomas. PMT photon-counting head triggers on-demand reverse-flow release of positive droplets.

steps.name: Positive hybridoma recovery
recovery_steps: Positive droplet released by reverse oil flow at 4 nL/s from outlet 1 (inlet 3 briefly opened to clear channel)
Droplet collected into glass capillary pre-filled with HFE7500 2% Ran Fluoro-surfactant
Glass capillary contents expelled onto 10-20 uL IMDM complete medium on hydrophobic PTFE membrane secured in 3D-printed holder
~1 mL FC-40 oil added to disrupt surfactant-stabilised emulsion; PTFE membrane absorbs HFE7500 and surfactant
Aqueous cell droplet released into IMDM complete medium
Merged droplet transferred to well-plate (e.g. 96-well) using pipette for downstream expansion or antibody characterisation assays
steps.downstream: Antibody characterisation (ELISA, sequencing, binding kinetics, etc.)

in_situ_generation.method: Phase change (single-phase aqueous to two-phase water-in-oil)
in_situ_generation.notes: Flow rate must be >1 nL/s to provide hydraulic pressure for phase exchange; not so high as to squeeze cell through constriction.

merge.notes: Two separate inlets used -- one for re-injected target droplets, one for oil spacer. No stream synchronisation required.

disruption.method: Electrostatic force (electrode actuation without emulsion destabiliser)
disruption.notes: Individual droplet disruption by electrostatic forces; avoids chemical demulsifiers that compromise cell viability. Droplets disrupted individually per trap -- no coalescence. Surfactant concentration in oil phase: 0.001% wt (no chemical emulsion destabiliser added).

release.electrode_actuation: none required (hydrodynamic release after wash droplet re-formation)
release.notes: Reverse flow of 2% Ran-HFE oil from outlet 1 at 4 nL/s. Inlet 3 briefly opened to clear previously accumulated droplets in that channel before collection.

performance.notes: Co-encapsulation efficiency of 95% is the highest reported without requiring preliminary sorting of both cell types or microvalve-based capture systems.

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.content: Device priming; target cell stain + encapsulation (Device 2); hybridoma stain; trapping (Device 1); sortSignal detect

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.content: PHI merge; dispose sortSignal; stain hybridoma; trap; trapOccupancySignal detect

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_7_j
basic_blocks.content: PHI merge; dispose trapOccupancySignal; in situ droplet generation; merge; incubate 30 min; wash; re-form droplet; antibodySignal detect

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_8_t
basic_blocks.action: dispense IMDM recovery medium; mix reforumDroplet -> recoveredCells; dispose recoveredCells

bioscript_notes.ir_output: 10 basic blocks (BB1-BB10), 3 if/else gates, 12 CFG edges
bioscript_notes.duration_units: All durations in seconds (s) or minutes (m); h token not supported by compiler
modules: singleCellTrapDetection (used for both sort gate and trap occupancy gate)
antibodyBindingDetection (Alexa Fluor 647 channel, post-wash SNR gate)
fixes_applied: Removed dead module declaration: targetCellSortDetection (declared but never called; singleCellTrapDetection covers both sort and trap occupancy gates)

Fixed imdmForHybridoma double-consumption: added imdmForHybridoma2 = dispense 1 units of IMDM_Medium inside BB5 (trap-pass branch) so each mix has its own fresh dispense unit; SSA compiler emits PHI imdmForHybridoma22 in BB7 join
bioscript_notes.ascii_compliance: All non-ASCII characters (em-dashes U+2014, arrow U+2192) replaced with ASCII equivalents (-- and ->) for ANTLR4 FileStream compatibility
bioscript_notes.biological_scope: This .bs file encodes the full mAb discovery screening workflow. Downstream antibody characterisation (sequencing, ELISA, binding kinetics) is off-chip and not encoded.
